note: DEMO SEED — UK race planner data for the HTC demo. Dates/venues are placeholders from public HYROX listings; refresh from hyrox.com before real use.

cities.name: London
cities.tagline: The big one. Multiple HYROX weekends a year and the fastest-selling tickets in the UK calendar.
cities.coachSays: Closest major race to us — two hours on the train and you're on the start line. Half the crew has raced here; the other half is about to.

race.name: HYROX London
race.expected: Next edition expected — dates land on hyrox.com first and sell out fast.

gettingThere: Christchurch to London Liverpool Street is about 1h 50m — book advance singles early, race weekend fills up.
Olympia is a short walk from Kensington (Olympia) station or Barons Court on the Piccadilly line.
Driving? Race-weekend parking around Kensington is painful and pricey — the train wins.

hotels.picks: Walk-to-venue options — the stress-free race morning.
Cheaper beds ten minutes from the venue.

food: Race morning: porridge or a bagel 3–4 hours out. Familiar food only — race day is not the day to experiment.
city: Contactless or Oyster everywhere on the Tube — no cash needed.
London HYROX weekends sell out hotels near the venue — book when tickets drop, not after.
nightAfter: Kensington and Hammersmith pubs do a roaring post-race trade — Sunday roast is basically mandatory.
cities.coachNote: This is the crew's home race — we take a proper contingent. If you're racing London, a 12-week block ending on race week is the sweet spot.

indoMeetup.note: Station 9 travels: whoever's racing finds the dinner. Pub booked near the venue, all levels welcome, race stories compulsory.

cities.name: Manchester
cities.tagline: The UK's biggest HYROX residency — multiple days, tens of thousands of athletes.
cities.coachSays: Eleven days of racing — if you can't find a wave that fits, that's on you. Worth the trip for the crowd alone.

race.name: HYROX Manchester
race.expected: Next residency expected — check hyrox.com for the announced block.

gettingThere: Christchurch to Manchester Piccadilly is around 4h 30m with one change — an overnighter makes sense.
Manchester Central is ten minutes on foot from Deansgate station.

hotels.picks: Walk everywhere, food on the doorstep.

food: Northern Quarter for carbs the night before — pasta options everywhere.
city: Stay near Deansgate and you won't need transport at all.
nightAfter: Northern Quarter — the obvious post-race dinner territory.
cities.coachNote: The multi-day format means we can get several crews through in one weekend — good first away race.

indoMeetup.note: Station 9 travels: crew dinner near the venue, all welcome.

cities.name: Birmingham
cities.tagline: NEC-scale HYROX — huge hall, huge field.
cities.coachSays: Big-arena energy. The NEC crowd makes you feel like a pro even when your sled disagrees.

race.name: HYROX Birmingham
race.expected: Next edition expected — dates land on hyrox.com.
race.address: North Ave, Marston Green, Birmingham B40 1NT

gettingThere: Birmingham International station is inside the NEC campus — trains via one change from Christchurch, ~3h.
Driving is easy — the NEC is built for it, parking on site.

hotels.picks: On-campus hotels mean a five-minute walk to your wave.

food: Resorts World next door covers pre-race dinner.
city: The NEC campus is self-contained — you won't see much of Birmingham itself unless you plan to.
nightAfter: Resorts World — restaurants five minutes from the hall.
cities.coachNote: Easiest logistics of the UK races — venue, hotel and dinner all within five minutes of each other.

indoMeetup.note: Station 9 travels: crew dinner at Resorts World, all welcome.

cities.name: Cardiff
cities.tagline: Welsh HYROX — a loud arena and a proper race-weekend city.
cities.coachSays: Long trip, worth it. Cardiff on race weekend is a city that actually notices you're there.

race.name: HYROX Cardiff
race.expected: Next edition expected — dates land on hyrox.com.

gettingThere: Cardiff Central station is a ten-minute walk from the arena — trains via one change, ~4h from Christchurch.

hotels.picks: Everything's walkable — venue, food, the lot.

food: Carbs on St Mary Street — you won't struggle.
city: Compact centre — book central and forget taxis.
nightAfter: St Mary Street for the post-race feed.
cities.coachNote: Furthest of the UK trips — we usually make a weekend of it.

indoMeetup.note: Station 9 travels: crew dinner in the city centre, all welcome.

cities.name: Glasgow
cities.tagline: Scottish HYROX at the SEC — the furthest trip and the friendliest crowd.
cities.coachSays: A proper expedition for us — fly it, don't sit on a train for seven hours.

race.name: HYROX Glasgow
race.expected: Next edition expected — dates land on hyrox.com.

gettingThere: Fly via a connection, or London direct — much easier than the 7h train.

hotels.picks: Walk to the venue and the best food street in town.

food: Finnieston is Glasgow's food strip — pick anywhere.
city: Cold even in spring — pack layers for queuing outside.
cities.coachNote: Only worth it as a committed trip — but as a crew weekend it's brilliant.

indoMeetup.note: Station 9 travels: crew dinner in Finnieston, all welcome.

alsoOn.name: HYROX Dublin
alsoOn.note: Short hop and a huge atmosphere — Dublin weekends sell out early.

alsoTba: Bristol, Leeds and Edinburgh are all expected back — dates land on hyrox.com first.
